name: Giant Snapping Turtle
otherStatistics: Natural armor AC 17, or AC 12 while prone. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A broad snapping turtle with a ridged olive-brown shell, heavy claws, a hooked beak, and a tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tomb of Annihilation, first printing (September 2017), Appendix D, p. 222. https://online.anyflip.com/njbp/dfek/mobile/index.html#p=223
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The turtle can breathe in air and water.
Stable. Whenever an effect knocks the turtle prone, it can try a DC 10 Constitution save to stay upright. When prone, it is upside down. To right itself, it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity check on its turn and then spend all its movement for that turn.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.At the table: Use AC 12 for an overturned turtle. The Constitution save prevents the fall. The Dexterity check and the full movement cost apply to righting it afterward.
sections.Encounter ecology: The appendix describes turtles up to 12 ft. across. Although slow-looking, they can lunge at smaller creatures that come close.

name: Hadrosaurus
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +2, passive Perception 12. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A crested duck-billed dinosaur with shorter forelimbs, a long balancing tail, and a muted rust crest.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tomb of Annihilation, first printing (September 2017), Appendix D, p. 224. https://online.anyflip.com/njbp/dfek/mobile/index.html#p=225
sections.Actions: Tail. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Use the appendix Tail attack. A hadrosaurus raised from a hatchling can learn to carry a Small or Medium rider.
sections.Encounter ecology: The Appendix B sighting is a grazing herd of 3d6 hadrosauruses that includes 1d6 noncombatant young. Adults defend themselves and their young if the party threatens them.

name: Jaculi
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +4, Perception +1, Stealth +4. Blindsight 30 ft., passive Perception 11. No languages.
appearance: A long coiled serpent with a bluish spined head and mottled bark-brown and stone-gray scales.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tomb of Annihilation, first printing (September 2017), Appendix D, p. 225. https://online.anyflip.com/njbp/dfek/mobile/index.html#p=226
sections.Traits:
Camouflage. Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide have advantage.
Keen Smell. Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell have advantage.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Spring. Move up to 30 ft. in a straight line, then make one Bite attack against a target in reach. The Bite has advantage if the snake springs at least 10 ft. On a hit, add 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
sections.At the table: Spring is one action with one Bite. The 10-ft. minimum is for advantage. A Spring hit adds the extra damage even on a shorter leap.
sections.Encounter ecology: Jaculis often wait coiled near trunks or pillars and spring toward prey. The adventure’s generic ambush on p. 201 uses 1d6 jaculis and surprises characters below passive Perception 14.

name: Quetzalcoatlus
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +2, passive Perception 12. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A long-necked pterosaur with a narrow toothless beak, a swept crest, and enormous leathery wings.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tomb of Annihilation, first printing (September 2017), Appendix D, p. 230. https://online.anyflip.com/njbp/dfek/mobile/index.html#p=231
sections.Traits:
Dive Attack. If the creature is flying, dives at least 30 ft. toward a target, and hits it with Bite, the attack deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.At the table: Use 10-ft. Bite reach. Dive Attack augments a qualifying Bite. Flyby applies to departure by flight.
sections.Encounter ecology: The creature can walk on four contact points but prefers to fly. The Appendix B flight is 1d4 + 1 animals and keeps its distance unless threatened.
